how_to_apply: Visit the official EIL recruitment portal at recruitment.eil.co.in.
Find Advertisement No. HRD/Rectt./Advt./2026-27/12 for experienced Associate Engineers.
Download and read the detailed recruitment notification.
Check the required qualification, experience, age and position code.
Open the online application form.
Select the eligible Associate Engineer position.
Enter personal and contact details correctly.
Provide a valid email address that will remain functional for at least 24 months.
Enter the required Engineering qualification and marks.
Enter the relevant post-qualification experience details.
Upload a recent passport-size colour photograph in JPG/JPEG format, not exceeding 75 KB.
Upload the scanned signature in JPG/JPEG format, not exceeding 25 KB.
Check the educational qualification marks and CGPA conversion instructions.
Review all information carefully.
Submit the online application before 9 December 2026 at 2:00 PM.
Save the generated registration number.
Download and print six copies of the submitted application form.
Affix a recent colour photograph to each copy as required.
Keep the original certificates and one self-attested photocopy set ready for the interview.
Attend the walk-in interview on the date and at the venue communicated by EIL.

content_sections.heading: EIL Vacancy 2026 - 87 Associate Engineer Posts
content_sections.text: Engineers India Limited has advertised 87 positions under 15 position codes. The recruitment includes five Grade I and 82 Grade II vacancies. Vacancy Highlight: The Piping discipline has the highest number of vacancies, with 30 Associate Engineer Grade II positions, followed by Structural Engineering with 12 and SMED 1 with eight positions. Reservation for eligible Persons with Disabilities will be implemented according to Government of India directives.

content_sections.heading: EIL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a relevant Engineering Degree with a minimum of 60% marks and the prescribed post-qualification experience as on 31 October 2026. Minimum Marks: Candidates must possess at least 60% marks in the prescribed Engineering Degree. The qualification must have been obtained within the prescribed minimum course duration. Associate Engineer Grade I applicants must have at least two years of relevant post-qualification experience in Electrical or Instrumentation Engineering. For Electrical Engineering, experience in design engineering for refineries, petrochemical plants, gas processing facilities, fertilizer plants, chemical plants, offshore projects, pipelines, LNG facilities or metallurgy plants is preferred. Instrumentation candidates should preferably possess experience in design and engineering of instrumentation and control systems. Experience with smart platforms is desirable. Grade II candidates must possess at least five years of relevant post-qualification experience. The required Engineering discipline depends on the position code, and preference may be given to candidates experienced in refinery, petrochemical, chemical, LNG, pipeline, infrastructure, power plant or other specified projects.

content_sections.heading: EIL Piping Engineer Recruitment 2026 - 30 Posts
content_sections.text: Engineers India Limited has announced 30 Associate Engineer Grade II - Piping vacancies under position code B3. Candidates should preferably possess experience in piping design and engineering for refineries, petrochemical plants, gas processing facilities, fertilizer plants, offshore projects, pipelines or LNG facilities. Working experience in smart platforms and piping stress analysis using CAESAR software is preferred.

content_sections.heading: EIL Civil and Structural Engineer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: EIL has announced vacancies for General Civil and Structural Engineering positions. General Civil candidates should preferably have experience in site grading, stormwater drainage, roads and underground piping infrastructure. Structural candidates should have knowledge of RCC and steel structural design, with experience using STAAD.Pro, SAP or similar structural analysis software considered desirable.

content_sections.heading: EIL Mechanical Engineer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Mechanical Engineering graduates can apply for eligible Piping, SMED, FED and related positions. The notification identifies preferred experience in static equipment design, rotating equipment, HVAC, equipment packages, fired heaters, reformers, crackers and thermal power plant engineering. Working knowledge of specialized engineering software, such as PV Elite, may be preferred for certain positions.

content_sections.heading: EIL Chemical and Environment Engineer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Chemical Engineering graduates are eligible for specified Safety, EWS, FED 3, Process 2 and Process 2 Alumina positions, subject to the advertised qualification and experience requirements. Preferred experience includes HSE studies, fire protection systems, HAZOP, SIL, quantitative risk assessment, water and wastewater treatment engineering, environmental impact assessment, process engineering and iron ore beneficiation or pellet plant operations.

content_sections.heading: EIL Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is calculated as on 31 October 2026 . PwD Eligibility: Candidates must possess at least 40% disability to claim reservation under the Persons with Disabilities category, subject to the applicable Government of India rules.

content_sections.heading: EIL Associate Engineer Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected Associate Engineers will receive consolidated monthly remuneration based on their grade and posting city classification. The above remuneration includes House Rent Allowance (HRA) and Provident Fund (PF). Selected fixed-term engineers will be eligible for the following benefits subject to company rules: Reimbursement of medical insurance premium for self for insurance coverage up to Rs. 2,00,000 per annum. Reimbursement of eligible out-of-pocket expenses for working beyond standard working hours. Coverage under the company's GPAI scheme. Travelling allowance for official duties outside the place of posting. Two days of paid leave for each completed month. Applicable living, R&R and other allowances during foreign postings.

content_sections.heading: EIL Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates should follow the instructions displayed on the official EIL application portal and should not make payments through unauthorized third-party websites.

content_sections.heading: EIL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Engineers India Limited will select eligible candidates through application screening and a personal interview. Online application registration. Screening of applications and educational qualifications. Verification of relevant post-qualification experience. Verification of original certificates on the interview day. Personal interview for eligible candidates. Selection and medical fitness assessment. Fixed-term engagement according to company requirements.

content_sections.heading: EIL Walk-in Interview 2026 Date and Venue
content_sections.text: The walk-in selection process will be conducted at Engineers India Limited offices in six cities. Interview Date: To be communicated separately by email. Reporting Time: 8:00 AM on the scheduled interview day. Important: The exact interview date, venue and reporting details will be communicated to candidates through their registered email addresses. Depending on the number of applicants, interviews may continue until 8:00 PM on the same day or extend to the following day. Candidates must make their own arrangements for travel and accommodation. No travel or accommodation allowance will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: EIL Recruitment 2026 Contract Duration
content_sections.text: The Associate Engineer positions are offered on a fixed-term contractual basis. Important: Fixed-term employment does not create any right to regular or permanent appointment with Engineers India Limited. The engagement will automatically terminate at the end of the applicable contractual period unless terminated earlier.

content_sections.heading: EIL Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must first register through the official EIL online recruitment website. Apply Online: recruitment.eil.co.in Application Start: 25 November 2026 at 2:00 PM. Application Last Date: 9 December 2026 at 2:00 PM. Candidates who have not completed their online application will not be entertained for the walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: EIL Recruitment 2026 Photograph and Signature Requirements
EIL Recruitment 2026 Documents Required for Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates attending the interview must carry six copies of the submitted online application form, original documents and one self-attested photocopy set. Six printed copies of the completed online application with recent colour photograph. Valid Government-issued photo identity proof. Class 10 certificate or birth certificate for date-of-birth verification. Class 10, Class 12 and Engineering qualification marksheets and certificates. Marksheet or passing certificate for every semester or year. Official CGPA/OGPA/CPI-to-percentage conversion certificate, where applicable. Original experience certificates for all employment declared in the application. Offer letters, confirmation orders, payslips, PF statements, ESI cards or bank statements where required to establish experience. Valid SC/ST certificate, where applicable. Valid OBC Non-Creamy Layer certificate, where applicable. Valid EWS certificate, where applicable. Disability certificate, where applicable. Ex-Servicemen discharge and other prescribed certificates, where applicable. Original No Objection Certificate from the current employer for eligible Government/PSU employees, or an employer certificate confirming that NOC is not applicable under company policy. Important: Candidates unable to produce original documents establishing their essential eligibility will not be considered for further selection.

content_sections.heading: EIL Recruitment 2026 CGPA Conversion Rules
content_sections.text: The notification requires candidates to provide documentary proof of the conversion standard adopted by their university or institution. Where such proof is unavailable, EIL has prescribed the following minimum CGPA/CPI equivalents for 60% marks. Application Rule: Candidates must round down the percentage of marks to the lower whole number. For example, 60.9% must be entered as 60%. CGPA must be rounded down to one decimal place; for example, 6.95 must be entered as 6.9.
